analysis.overview: Both frames align on labeling uncertain assumptions and on procedure-level resource visibility for feasibility review. The reference additionally concentrates on formative prototype scope and iteration constraints, while the compared frame adds deployment dependencies, partner commitments, operational ownership, and field volatility.

relations.reason: Clarifying each resource’s fabrication or study stage and tracing resources to prototype features or field procedures are complementary forms of resource-to-work traceability.

reports.both: Both require schedule, recruitment, and technical uncertainties to be labeled, and connect feasibility assessment to resources mapped to prototype work and research procedures.
reports.compared_only: The compared frame adds field-partner commitment tracking, deployment support ownership, visibility of external dependencies, and operational changes to schedules and staffing.
reports.reference_only: The reference adds minimum prototype scope, iteration feasibility, between-iteration modification capacity, and recruitment-delay effects on modification time.
